name: web-dark-green-blur-ai-growth-hero-with-glass-stat-cards
title: Black hero with blurred lime-green light, italic emphasis words, sparkles and glass stat cards
whatItIs: A rounded black hero with big blurred green light shapes, a pill nav with outlined and green buttons, a headline 'The Future of Growth is Automated' with italic lime and white emphasis words and two sparkles, a glowing outlined CTA, a logo row and two glass cards (Active Nodes, Efficiency Boost) on the right.
whatItMeans: Futuristic and energetic; blurred light gives an AI product an organic glow.
techniques: Use out-of-focus green light as the hero art.
Italicise key words in the headline.
Add sparkle glyphs beside the text.
Show small glass stat cards with mini icons.

vocabulary.definition: Key words in italic and accent colour.
A translucent card with a metric.
A button with a soft luminous border.
